selection_note: 22 real 2026 pieces: 17 analyses, two research report landing pages, two testimonies and one policy toolkit. September stream plus selected current-year context, not the 22 newest posts site-wide. Dates and authors are page bylines; report landing-page author is distinct from underlying report authors. Source em dashes in two titles are normalized to colons; wording is unchanged. Topics and type labels are proposed editorial metadata. Declarations in summaries describe Yankee’s arguments, not independently verified policy outcomes.
